links.outcome: Readability (Flesch reading ease) of chatbot answers to SLE patient questions
links.effect: Readability for all 3 chatbots was low, median Flesch reading ease score 42.22-46.66; may limit accessibility for patient use.
links.quote: Readability for all 3 chatbots was low (median Flesch reading ease score 42.22-46.66).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the accuracy and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemini 2.5 Flash) in answering patient FAQs about systemic lupus erythematosus, but it does not test a deployment practice or guardrail.
